distinct_from: v7_media.piper_decoder's libritts-high model, which is not the available local asset
conditioning: Only current shared-state predicted probabilities; argmax selects a digit word for each public event; run neural ONNX synthesis on every call
output_observer: Consensus of independent target-free unrestricted-vocabulary Vosk word events and Whisper tiny.en complete transcript; no prompts, candidate labels, grammar or expected text supplied
event_audit: Vosk must observe exactly one digit word in each one-second event with start/end tolerance 0.08 seconds; Whisper must independently agree on both digits
whisper_parser: Digit words and single digits; a two-digit numeric token may be separated under the fixed two-event output grammar; other lexical tokens fail
audit_cache: Offline measurement only, keyed by complete actual PCM bytes; every cache hit is disclosed; never cache generated waveforms
qualification: Keep FSDD neural auditor/input qualification separate from external ASR waveform-domain qualification; the latter is actual conditional synthesis scored by independent ASR
comparison: Retain all VAE negatives and hard/soft states. Piper uses argmax in both conditions, so its audio contrast is identically conditioned and is not evidence for soft/hard superiority.
